venturi_area_upper_bound_mm2.qualification: Geometric area limit; not discharge area.

compression_ratio_interpretations.qualification: Conditional arithmetic only; source254V shows2cm3checking insert and minimum9.7total. Neither interpretation is asserted to be measured operating clearance; no automatic subtraction.

crankcase_volume_family.qualification: One independent free volume or same-engine primary compression ratio is required. No source equation closes Vmin.

clearance_volume_TDC_cm3.reason: Manual documents nominal10.15cm3. Operational gauge/insert convention remains unresolved; an explicitly stated nominal interpretation can be a preliminary hypothesis and is not the sole hard blocker.

crankcase_free_volume_at_known_angle_cm3.reason: 254V pp3,5,45,46 do not determine3Dconnected gas volume minus crank/rod/piston intrusion. A partial inside view and crankshaft width cannot close cavity volume. Need one assembled free volume at known angle or same-engine primary ratio with volume definition.

actual_port_area_angle_and_transfer_pass.reason: 254V p4 gives timing, width limits and a section; p44 gives checking profiles. Nominal piston opening and arc-width bounds are derivable. Rounded window shape and out-of-plane duct area/centreline are not uniquely dimensioned; a stated reduced1D approximation may be defensible preliminarily, not an exact measured transfer map.

installed_intake_path_and_exhaust_spacer.reason: Manual gives specific430–440mm setting and50–60mmclosed flexible. A declared nominal length within the public range is permissible before prediction; it is not the tested assembly or entire pipe length. Carburetor and reed dimensions support a nominal intake reduction, not exact3Ddischarge.

reed_force_lift_stop_and_discharge.reason: Geometry/thickness do not identify stiffness or effective discharge; preliminary component assumptions must be declared and never power-fitted. Not independently identified for the tested engine.

thermal_wall_conditions.reason: May use declared boundary estimates, without claiming measured thermal state or adjusting to power.

fuel_properties_and_actual_AFR.reason: Published lambda may define an approximate comparison; actual fuel and stoichiometry must remain declared and not fabricated.

combustion_and_scavenging_closure.reason: A fixed reduced closure may be tested as a hypothesis; no identification or predictive claim and no adjustment against curve.

mechanical_losses_and_measurement_plane.reason: Without loss/plane identification, indicated result cannot be called measured brake-power agreement.

exact_test_conditions_and_raw_uncertaint.reason: Graph reading alone remains useful but is not a metrologically complete validation dataset.

revision_match_to_experimental_engine.reason: Current254V drawing and article drawing have differences; do not hybridize silently.
